faq.q: Which SkyTrain serves Surrey condo buyers now, and what is coming?
faq.a: The live page names Scott Road, Gateway, Surrey Central and King George as Surrey's current Expo Line stations, and TransLink states the Surrey-Langley extension will run 16 km along Fraser Highway from King George Station to 203 Street in Langley City, with an anticipated in-service date of 2029.
